title: Light Kenyan Milk Mushimono
description: A briny, glassy-jelly, sweetened condensed milk dessert originating from Kenya, suitable for a sugar-free diet.
instructions: Combine the sweetened condensed milk, water, and melted ghee or butter in a medium saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened slightly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the salt, vanilla extract, cinnamon powder, and cardamom powder.
Pour the mixture into a shallow dish or mold and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Once set, slice the Light Kenyan Milk Mushimono into small pieces and serve chilled.
Note: If desired, garnish with a sprinkle of cardamom powder or a few strands of saffron for added flavor and visual appeal.
